output.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.product_id) AS distinct_products
FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l
JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.country = 'France'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: Counts the unique products on order lines for customers in France, for orders dated in 2025. All statuses are included, as requested, so there is no revenue filter. It assumes the country is stored as 'France' rather than a country code; I haven't checked this against the data.
